audit.whatIsWrong: Verdict correct and both layers already agree; the difficulty was never grounded in why.
audit.why: 55.71% over 1260 games, FAVOURED 4/10. Packet levelChart is Fizz on all seven and content win[0..6] and full phases[].side both read Fizz on all seven — no cross-layer disagreement to fix. Orianna has no dash in her kit; her only defensive tool is Command: Protect on a flat 9s, and Shockwave is a 410-radius pull with no mobility attached.
audit.corrected: Chart left untouched. Difficulty grounded in her missing dash and the ball's travel time.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere in the spike or cooldown text.
audit.why: Fizz spikes at 3, 6, first item. Orianna's spikes are Command: Shockwave at 110/95/80s and the fact that Command: Protect is a flat 9s at every rank, so her shield is effectively always available in lane — that is the number that decides whether a pre-6 dive is worth it.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, loading and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said to track the ball but never said the mechanical reason: Shockwave launches enemies toward the BALL, not toward Orianna.
audit.why: Riot's Command: Shockwave text: the ball unleashes a shockwave 'launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay'. So her threat range is the ball's position, not hers — that is the single fact that decides where you can stand. Playful/Trickster's untargetability is the answer to the delayed pull. Fizz's passive walks through units, so the 815-range Command: Attack cannot use the wave to line him up.
audit.corrected: Written into winCon, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Shockwave 110/95/80s and Command: Protect flat 9s are both in the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] names a non-existent ability, 'Command: Shield'. wants.foe[1] attributes a pull to Command: Dissonance.
audit.why: Orianna's abilities are Clockwork Windup, Command: Attack, Command: Dissonance, Command: Protect, Command: Shockwave. There is no Command: Shield. Dissonance leaves a field that speeds allies and slows enemies — it does not pull; the pull is Shockwave.

notes:
CHART: no edits needed — packet levelChart, content win[0..6] and full phases[].side all read Fizz on all seven rows, and the whys agree. This is the one matchup in my slice where the two layers were already consistent.

DECISIVE FACT ADDED: Command: Shockwave launches enemies 'towards the Ball' (Riot's own text), so Orianna's threat range is the ball's position and not hers. The page told the reader to track the ball but never said why, which left it as flavour rather than a rule.

TWO NAME ERRORS FIXED that the packet did not flag: wants.foe[0] referred to 'Command: Shield', which is not an Orianna ability, and wants.foe[1] called Command: Dissonance a pull — Dissonance leaves a slow field; the pull is Shockwave.

report[1].t, report[4].t and report[11].t remain misgendered (lint MISGENDER) — outside the two-report sweep cap.

UNVERIFIED, not written: whether Command: Protect can be self-cast for the shield (Riot's text says it attaches to 'an allied champion'), so I described the 9s cooldown rather than asserting she shields herself; and whether Playful/Trickster's untargetability prevents the Shockwave displacement itself or only its damage.
